verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS voice platform that ships a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. HIPAA compliance mode controls how call recordings and logs are stored, which is an adjacent data-retention control, not a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
